notes.title: My game has officially launched!
notes.notes: [p]As my first project, it may have some rough edges, but I poured my heart into making it the best I could.[/p][p]I’ve learned so much through this experience, and I’ll work even harder to create an even better game next time.[/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who played and supported my game![/p]

notes.title: The demo has been updated.
notes.notes:
Key changes include:

CCTV can now be controlled with the mouse, improving immersion and depth.

A battery gauge has been added to the fullscreen view, introducing a risk element.

Bug fixes

UI improvements

Minor anomaly additions

thank you

notes.title: Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
We've prepared a short demo for Steam Next Fest.
If you enjoyed it, please consider adding us to your wishlist!

notes.title: Anomaly Report in the Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
As this is my very first game, which I developed entirely on my own, it holds a special place in my heart. Naturally, I have a strong hope that it will be well received.
The game itself is already complete, with the exception of translations, and I'm proud of how far it's come.

After researching countless ways to succeed on Steam, I realized how important it is to take part in the Next Fest.
Thanks to the incredible support from everyone who has already added the game to their wishlist, I'm truly grateful and happy — but I've decided to gather even more wishlists before officially launching the game.

I sincerely apologize for the delay, and thank you for your patience.
Anomaly Report will be released immediately after the Steam Next Fest ends.
Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: Game Release Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
We’re working hard to launch the game by the end of April—or early May at the latest.
Thank you so much to everyone who has been waiting and added the game to their wishlist!

The goal of the game is to survive for 8 days across two floors: the ground floor and the first floor.
Currently, the ground floor is 100% complete, and the first floor is about 85% done.
Thank you again!
